relations.text: GlobalFoundriesがMarvellの光製品向けに、Burlington工場のSiGe生産能力を増やす複数年契約を拡大

relations.text: MicrosoftがAzure Cloud HSM向けにMarvellのLiquidSecurity HSMを採用

source.quote: Microsoft has selected the Marvell ® LiquidSecurity ® family of hardware security modules (HSMs) for Microsoft Azure Cloud HSM.

relations.text: MicrosoftがAzure内でMarvellのLiquidSecurity HSMを幅広く利用

source.quote: Microsoft—which extensively uses the Marvell ® LiquidSecurity ® family of HSMs to perform encryption, key management, and other security functions within Azure

relations.text: Marvell、Microsoft、UtimacoがMarvell LiquidSecurity技術を組み合わせたAzure Payment HSM v2を提供

relations.text: MarvellとAWSが5年間の契約で戦略的関係を拡大し、EDAでのAWSクラウド利用を含む

source.label: Marvell の発表
source.quote: the expansion of their strategic relationship with Amazon Web Services (AWS) through a five-year, multi-generational agreement that includes collaboration across multiple AWS products and the use of AWS cloud infrastructure
source.note: AWSはMarvellのクラウド顧客でもあります。対象は協業とクラウドEDAの利用です。
source.note_en: AWS is also a Marvell cloud customer; the agreement concerns collaboration and cloud EDA usage.
